title: Qualify the exact M8 native admission contract and preserve completed Math history
commitMessage: docs: qualify exact 39-node M8 admission design before native insertion

contribution.summary: Qualify a bounded, owner-approved M8 admission contract for independent Math Discovery and .NET 11 modernization without inserting unvalidated native nodes.
contribution.value: Define exact product and DWF identities for M8, two work packages, four phases, eight tasks and twenty-four subtasks, plus their initial not-ready states and dependencies. Supply an independent C# validator to preserve the 541-node completed M0-M7 baseline before atomic canonical admission.
debtChanges: RS180 succeeded at attempt 001 after one preparation-compilation refusal; first-pass was not achieved. The installed DWF 0.1.66 typed native subtree APIs are now observed, not assumed.
M8-M12 are an approved strategic order. M8 is not admitted by this run; the canonical backlog remains 0.1.122 and native plan preserves all completed M0-M7 nodes.
The historic M3-W03 Discovery proposal remains a draft. Its accepted future work is remapped to new M8-W01 rather than retroactively inserted under completed M3.
RS181 creates one exact 39-node design contract and a bounded C# validation gate; no SDK migration, package publication, skill, AURA integration or native plan mutation is claimed.
contribution.nextAction: After durable success, prepare one atomic M8 admission run using installed typed DWF milestone insertion, canonical backlog and mapping reconciliation, generated projections and native validator updates.
